item.title: Querying All Tables and Views in Oracle SQL 2023
item.description: Querying all tables and views in an Oracle database is a common task for data exploration and understanding the database structure. This article guides you through the process of retrieving a comprehensive list of all tables and views using SQL queries in Oracle, incorporating knowledge relevant to the year 2023. 1. Using System Catalog Views: In Oracle, the system catalog views ALL_TABLES and ALL_VIEWS store information about tables and views accessible to the user.
